title: The Ruined Watchtower
text: A watchtower stands black against the sky on a hill, its stair half gone, an old beacon basket at its crown. From the top you could see the whole way ahead. A crow sits on the beacon, watching you climb the slope.

options.label: The quickest climbs the broken stair to see the way ahead.

outcomes.text: From the top they see the way, the danger and a shortcut.
The stair gives at the top. They come down faster than they went up.

options.label: Light the old beacon to call whoever still keeps watch.

outcomes.text: Somewhere someone answers, and sends help.

options.label: Walk on by; the crow can keep its tower.

outcomes.text: Without the view from the top, you walk straight into what you would have seen.
